title: Staging behind Cloudflare Access, no service token: the login redirect is not the app

mustFind.why: The tool must say it could not reach the app. Silence on a gated host reads as a clean bill of health while nothing was tested (the old behaviour: every live check quietly stopped at the redirect).

mustNotFlag.why: The missing CSP, HSTS and frame headers are those of Cloudflare's 302, not of the app behind it.
CF_AppSession is Cloudflare's own login cookie, not a session cookie of the app.
A 302 to the team's cloudflareaccess.com login is Access itself, not an open redirect.
Nothing on a host Crenel could not reach is proven: the gate is reported as one info lead, never as a pass or a fail of the app.
